intake.prompt: Extract the idea, mission or business objective, stakeholders, constraints, assumptions, unknowns, success metrics, and mission class cues. Return only structured fields and confidence notes.

clarification.prompt: Ask only the smallest set of missing high-impact questions needed to make architecture and lifecycle planning credible. Prioritize destination, payload, schedule, budget band, autonomy level, jurisdiction, and regulatory posture.

conops.prompt: Draft the concept of operations with mission scenario, operational modes, environment, success criteria, failure conditions, key interfaces, and nominal/off-nominal flows. Tie each section back to objectives and constraints.

architecture.prompt: Generate 2 to 4 candidate system architectures, identify pros, cons, design drivers, interface implications, and mission fit, then nominate a baseline only after comparing options.

trade_study.prompt: Score candidate architectures against weighted criteria such as mission performance, schedule, cost, risk, technology maturity, autonomy, and policy fit. Record rationale, uncertainties, and the selected baseline.

requirements.prompt: Derive mission, system, subsystem, and interface requirements from objectives and ConOps. Every requirement must be testable, traceable, and mapped to a verification method and review gate.

subsystems.prompt: Decompose the baseline into a product-oriented WBS covering payload, structures, thermal, EPS, C&DH, avionics, communications, GNC, software, AIT, ground segment, mission ops, safety, quality, legal, and disposal. For each subsystem capture drivers, interfaces, artifacts, and verification hooks.

risk.prompt: Identify technical, schedule, cost, safety, supply-chain, radiation, and policy risks. Assign likelihood, consequence, mitigation, owner role, trigger, and closure evidence.

compliance.prompt: Translate lifecycle, policy, debris, spectrum, licensing, registration, and interoperability obligations into executable checklist items with review gates, evidence artifacts, and source references.

checklists.prompt: Generate actionable checklist items by phase and subsystem. Every item must include id, phase, subsystem, task, purpose, inputs, dependencies, owner_role, evidence_artifact, exit_criteria, review_gate, risk_if_skipped, and source_refs.
